source.method: Onkelos-supported lexical anchors as starting point; every verse reviewed word by word (reviewed.json)

1:10.note: פן ירבה = "before they multiply"; והיה כי = "lest".

1:11.note: שרי מסים = "evil overseers"; ערי מסכנות = "towns, storehouses".

1:12.note: יפרץ = 'grew strong'; periphrastic ܗܘܘ linked to its verb; impersonal ܥܩܬ ܠܗܘܢ = ויקצו.

1:16.note: 'When they kneel' for על האבנים; periphrastic ܗܘܝܬܝܢ linked to its verb; וחיה turned into 'you shall keep her alive'; plus 'to them'.

2:5.note: Plus copula ܗܘܝ; בתוך הסוף = "in the shallows".

2:9.note: היליכי rendered "behold, to you"; plus ܠܟܝ.

2:11.note: Plus "from the sons of Israel"; plus ܟܕ.

2:18.note: "Why have you watered so quickly today".

2:22.note: Long plus on the birth of Eliezer (cf. Ex 18:4).

3:1.note: "Behind the wilderness" rendered "to the wilderness"; mountain of God paraphrased with suffix.

3:2.note: "Behold" omitted; relative clause "in which fire was kindled" for burning with fire.

3:3.note: Particle na omitted; "why" rendered by two words.

3:5.note: Plus "to him"; "ground of holiness" rendered "holy place".

3:6.note: Emphatic "I I"; proleptic pronoun for face.

3:7.note: "Affliction" rendered "subjection"; plus pronoun "I" and proleptic "to him".

3:8.note: "Good and wide" reversed; "place of" rendered "land of".

3:12.note: Plus "to him God I"; "to you" omitted.

3:13.note: Plus "the LORD" before "God of your fathers".

3:18.note: Plus "sons of"; "met" rendered "was revealed"; particle na omitted.

3:21.note: "Favour of this people" restructured "give them to mercy"; "this" omitted.

3:22.note: Gold and silver vessels in reversed order; "put on" rendered "clothe".

4:9.note: "Also" omitted; doubled "and they shall be" rendered once.

4:13.note: Plus "Moses"; "bi" paraphrased "I beseech you"; na omitted.

4:19.note: "Go, return" reordered; plus ethical dative and copula.

4:21.note: "Which I put" rendered "which I did" in your hands.

4:23.note: "Refuse" rendered "if you are not willing"; plus "my son".

4:25.note: "Touched" rendered "seized"; "you are to me" rendered "there is to me".

4:31.note: "Remembered"/"subjection" renderings; plus "the people" and "before the LORD".

5:3.note: Plus "the LORD"; "pestilence or sword" rendered "sword or death"; na omitted.

5:7.note: "Yesterday, day before" expanded with comparative particles.

5:9.note: "Do it" read as "think on it" (both verbs as sh-'-h).

5:13.note: "Day by day" paraphrased "as at all times"; "when straw was given to you".

5:16.note: "Your people sins" rendered "you sin against your people".

5:19.note: "You shall not diminish ... but as every day"; plus "to them".

6:1.note: Second "strong hand" rendered "uplifted arm"; "drive out" rendered "bring out".

6:3.note: Plus "God"; "I was not known to them" rendered "I did not show them".

6:6.note: Plus 'God' and 'with a strong hand'; 'burdens' rendered 'subjection'; enclitic ܐܢܐ linked to its verb.

6:20.note: "His aunt" rendered "daughter of his uncle"; plus Miriam.

6:30.note: "Uncircumcised of lips" rendered "my tongue stammers"; "behold" omitted.

7:7.note: Plus copula; numbers in Syriac order.

7:13.note: "Did not listen to them" rendered "did not send them".

7:23.note: "Also" omitted; "set his heart" rendered "bring upon his mind".

8:1.note: Plus "your brother"; "rivers, canals" rendered with different water terms.

8:5.note: "Glory over me" rendered "ask for yourself"; "only in the river they shall remain" omitted.

8:17.note: Plus 'willing' and 'of every kind'; 'your servants' omitted; ܘܥܠ renders the וב prefix of the following noun; ܐܝܟ for וגם left unlinked.

8:22.note: Second "abomination" rendered "fear"; negation of "will they not stone us" omitted.

9:4.note: "Sons of Israel" rendered "house of Israel"; "nothing" rendered "not even one".

9:6.note: "Sons of Israel" rendered "house of Israel"; "not even one".

9:11.note: "Because of the boil, for the boil was" merged.

9:17.note: "Exalt yourself" rendered "hold on to them"; plus "not willing".

9:21.note: "Set his heart" rendered "bring upon his heart".

9:28.note: "Enough" paraphrased "there is much room before him".

10:2.note: "In the ears of" rendered "before"; "made sport of" rendered "did".

10:3.note: "Refuse to humble yourself" rendered "not willing to fear me".

10:5.note: Plus "son of man" as subject of "see".

10:7.note: "Do you not yet know" rendered "until now you do not know".

10:9.note: "Elders" rendered "old men"; "feast of the LORD" restructured.

10:11.note: "That (service) you seek" rendered "rest you seek"; "drove out" rendered "brought out".

10:14.note: Word order of comparison clauses rearranged.

10:17.note: "Lift my sin" rendered "forgive my fault"; na and "only" omitted.

10:26.note: "Not a hoof" expanded "not even one nail here".

10:28.note: Plus "to Moses"; "see my face" rendered "appear to me".

10:29.note: "You have spoken right" rendered "you said well".

11:1.note: "When he sends you, he will surely drive you out" rendered "go out all of you".

11:3.note: "Gave favour" rendered "gave them to mercy"; "great" rendered "honoured".

11:8.note: Plus "to me", "Moses"; "at your feet" rendered "with you".

12:3.note: "Speak" rendered "say"; plus "sons of"; order "lamb for a house / for his father's house" reversed.

12:4.note: "Too small for a lamb" paraphrased "too small that a lamb go out in it".

12:5.note: "Unblemished" paraphrased "in which is no blemish"; goats rendered "kids".

12:6.note: "Kept" rendered passive "guarded"; "day" omitted; "between the evenings" rendered "at sunset".

12:9.note: 'Raw' rendered ܚܝ; ܐܦ (ܠܐ) for ו of ובשל; על/ועל replaced by ܘ ('and its legs and its inwards'); ܟܕ plus.

12:12.note: "I will smite" rendered "shall die"; "gods of Egypt" rendered "idols (fears)".

12:17.note: "Bone (selfsame) of this day" rendered "in it, in this day".

12:18.note: "In the first" expanded "in the first month".

12:22.note: "Blood in the basin" rendered "blood of the lamb"; "touch" rendered "sprinkle".

12:26.note: "To you" omitted; word order of question changed.

12:27.note: Plus "to them" and "to the LORD"; "pass over" rendered "spare".

12:29.note: "House of the pit" rendered "house of prisoners".

12:39.note: "Driven out of Egypt" rendered "the Egyptians brought them out".

13:7.note: Second clause "no leaven shall be seen" omitted.

13:10.note: Plus "and this law"; "from days to days" rendered "from time to time".

13:12.note: "Cause to pass" rendered "set apart"; "firstling of cattle" rendered "opening of the womb of cattle".

13:13.note: "Firstling of an ass" generalized to "firstborn male of cattle"; "break its neck" rendered "kill it".

14:2.note: Pi-hahiroth rendered "mouth of the ditch"; "sons" rendered "house".

14:4.note: Plus "the LORD said to Moses"; "after them" rendered "after you".

14:9.note: Plus "encamped"; Pi-hahiroth rendered "mouth of the ditch".

14:14.note: Plus 'and Moses prayed before the LORD'; periphrastic ܬܗܘܘܢ ܫܠܝܢ = תחרישון.

14:19.note: "Angel of God" rendered "angel of the LORD".

14:20.note: Plus "all the night" and "to the sons of Israel".

14:29.note: "On dry land in the sea" rendered "in the sea as on dry land".

15:1.note: Song=השירה; את unrendered; Syriac adds ܥܠ "over" before horses.

15:2.note: Plus ܡܪܝܐ after ܝܗ; ܠܢ "to us" for לי.

15:5.note: Object suffix as ܐܢܘܢ; plus ܘܛܒܥܘ "and they sank".

15:7.note: Object suffix as ܐܢܘܢ; ܐܝܟ ܕܠܚܒܬܐ for כקש.

15:9.note: תמלאמו rendered "swallow them"; object suffixes as ܐܢܘܢ.

15:19.note: ܡܪܝܐ moved after ܥܠܝܗܘܢ; plus ܒܓܘ.

15:22.note: Plus ܡܪܕܐ "journey"; ܠܕܒܝܬ marks את ישראל.

15:23.note: Plus "of that place"; לא יכלו rendered "could not find".

15:25.note: Plus ܡܘܫܐ; שם לו rendered "taught him".

16:1.note: Day number (יום) not rendered; plus ܒܙܒܢܐ and "sons of Israel".

16:3.note: מי יתן as "would that"; הקהל הזה rendered "congregation of the sons of Israel".

16:5.note: ܡܕܡ ܕ for אשר; משנה as "one two" (double).

16:7.note: כבוד as ܫܘܒܚܐ; על יהוה as "before the Lord"; ketiv/qere doublet.

16:12.note: בין הערבים as "at sunset"; דבר not rendered separately.

16:14.note: Second דק not rendered; ܘܩܪܝܡ unclear plus.

16:17.note: Paraphrase "some who gathered much, some little".

16:29.note: ממקומו as "from the door of his house"; תחתיו as "in his place".

16:34.note: ܦܩܕܢܝ 'commanded me' replaces אל משה; לפני and למשמרת rendered freely.

16:36.note: "One of ten" for עשירית; ephah rendered seah.

17:5.note: קח rendered "lead"; את unrendered, ܠ marks object.

17:16.note: יה not rendered separately; כס as "throne".

18:1.note: ܡܕܡ ܕ for אשר; ܠܒܢܝ marks object (plus "sons of").

18:6.note: Passive "it was told Moses, behold" for אני (reading הנה).

18:9.note: Plus "and from the hand of Pharaoh" (from 18:10).

18:11.note: בדבר אשר זדו rendered "because of the plan they plotted".

18:12.note: Plus ܫܠܡܐ; לאלהים as "to the Lord".

18:15.note: לדרש אלהים as "to ask a word from God".

18:18.note: נבל תבל as "you will be distressed".

18:19.note: Plus ܡܠܦܢܐ "teacher"; מול האלהים as "from God".

18:23.note: על מקמו as "each to his house".

18:26.note: Periphrastic participles; כל before small matter not rendered.

19:1.note: Syriac reads "wilderness of Sin" for Sinai; plus ܒܗ.

19:5.note: סגלה as "beloved"; plus "of the earth"; כל of last clause not rendered.

19:12.note: והגבלת read as העיד/"set a testimony"; סביב and לכם not rendered.

19:13.note: במשך היבל as "when the horn falls silent"; plus ܫܪܐ "permitted".

19:15.note: "for the third day" for three days.

20:2.note: הוצאתיך rendered "brought you up"; doubled ܐܢܐ.

20:15.note: ראים rendered as participle; וינעו as "feared".

20:20.note: Gold and silver in reversed order.

20:21.note: שלמים as "offerings"; אזכיר read as 2nd person "you remember".

21:2.note: עברי rendered "Jew/Judaean"; plus "from you"; חנם not rendered.

21:6.note: האלהים rendered "judges"; ועבדו as "be to him servant, worker".

21:8.note: Ketiv לא followed; יעדה as "take her"; לעם read as "with".

21:22.note: Plus "two"; בפללים as "as the judges decide".

21:30.note: ככל אשר יושת as "as much as they ask of him".

22:3.note: Plus ܟܕ; "one by two" for שנים.

22:10.note: ולקח בעליו as "the owner accepts the oaths".

22:22.note: כי אם צעק יצעק as "and they pray before me".

22:24.note: כנשה as "like a creditor"; תשימון as "take from him".

22:28.note: מלאתך ודמעך as "first of threshing floor and winepress".

23:8.note: פקחים as "eyes of the wise"; plus "in judgment".

23:13.note: אלהים rendered "idols"; על פיך as "upon your heart".

23:16.note: Free rendering of the ingathering clause.

23:27.note: והמתי rendered "destroy"; turn their neck "before you".

23:33.note: כי תעבד rendered as prohibition "and do not serve".

24:7.note: "We will hear and do" in reversed order.

25:2.note: ידבנו לבו rendered 'who resolves in his heart'; 'house of Israel'.

25:20.note: אל הכפרת rendered "above the mercy seat".

25:26.note: Plus "four of gold"; אשר ל as "above".

26:1.note: ܨܘܒܥܐ "dyed" for תולעת; ܠ marks object.

26:13.note: "From one side ... from the other side".

27:11.note: Ketiv/qere doublet; קלעים מאה אורך as "100 cubits".

28:4.note: Order robe/ephod/breastpiece differs; תשבץ as "of fine linen".

28:30.note: Urim and Thummim as "light and perfection"; heart as "breast".

29:1.note: "This is the thing" rendered freely as "and thus"; asher not rendered.

29:2.note: Word-for-word; "fine flour of wheat" rendered "sifted (flour) of wheat".

29:5.note: Plus "turban"; "robe of the ephod" reduced to "robe".

29:8.note: Object suffix of MT verb rendered by separate pronoun.

29:13.note: "Fat which is on them" rendered "their fat"; 'al before liver not rendered.

29:16.note: Partitive "from his blood" for et damo; sabib rendered "round about".

29:20.note: "Right" added also for Aaron's ear; "put" rendered "sprinkle".

29:25.note: Plus "the breast from the ram"; MT otam not rendered.

29:38.note: Asher not rendered; order of "continually" and "daily" swapped.

29:42.note: Final sham not rendered; "to you (sg)" rendered "with you (pl)".

29:46.note: Ani doubled as in Syriac idiom.

30:6.note: Asher before "I will meet" rendered by "and".

30:7.note: Periphrastic "shall be burning"; "morning by morning" rendered "from morning to morning".

30:16.note: MT oto not rendered; "your souls" rendered "their souls".

31:10.note: "Plaited garments" rendered "garments of service"; plus "to me".

31:13.note: Lemor and akh not rendered; "keep" rendered periphrastically.

31:17.note: Plus "and the seas and all that is in them"; "sons of Israel" rendered "house of Israel".

32:1.note: Word-for-word; "this Moses, the man" reordered as "this man Moses".

32:4.note: "These are your gods" rendered singular "this is your god"; heret rendered "mould".

32:6.note: Doublet "sacrificed peace offerings and brought offerings"; plus "and to make merry".

32:7.note: "Go down" reordered; plus "from here"; "brought up" rendered "brought out".

32:11.note: Lamah rendered as negative "let not"; "land of" not rendered; "strong hand" rendered "high arm".

32:12.note: Lamah rendered "lest"; lemor not rendered; "turn from the fierceness" rendered "be appeased from the fury".

32:18.note: Plus "to him Moses"; MT "sound of singing" (12th word 'annot) rendered "of sin"; second "singing" not rendered.

32:19.note: Mecholot rendered "cymbals"; ketiv/qere "from his hand(s)" both linked.

32:20.note: Plus "with a file", "like dust", "its powder"; "sons of Israel" rendered "house of Israel".

32:24.note: "Take it off" rendered "bring to me"; plus "has".

32:25.note: Free rendering: "they sinned, Aaron made them sin, to have an evil name in their posterity".

32:29.note: Plus "to them"; ki rendered "because" in second clause.

33:1.note: "Go up" reordered; "brought up" rendered "brought out"; "your seed" pluralized.

33:2.note: "I will drive out" rendered "and he will destroy".

33:14.note: Plus "the Lord to Moses"; "my face" rendered "before me".

34:7.note: Plus "generations" twice; three sin terms rendered by two.

34:10.note: "Were not created" rendered "were not done"; plus "this".

34:11.note: "Drive out" rendered "destroy"; Amorite and Canaanite swapped.

34:15.note: "Whore" rendered "go astray"; "their gods" rendered "their idols" first time.

34:16.note: Plus "and give your daughters to their sons".

34:30.note: "Sons of" not rendered; hinneh rendered by relative.

34:34.note: Periphrastic imperfects; "sons of Israel" rendered "house of Israel".

34:35.note: "Put back the veil on his face" rendered "took the veil from his face".

35:3.note: "Kindle" rendered "take hold of"; "dwellings" rendered "houses of your dwelling".

35:4.note: Both lemor not rendered; plus "to do".

35:5.note: "Willing of heart" rendered "man who thought in his heart".

35:12.note: "Veil of the screen" rendered "front of the door of the covering".

36:2.note: "Whose heart stirred him" rendered "who thought in his heart".

36:3.note: "Holy work" rendered "work of the tabernacle"; "freewill offering" rendered "offering".

36:22.note: Plus "and two tenons for one board".

36:29.note: Obscure "double ... complete to its head" rendered freely.

38:3.note: Utensil list rendered with partly different items; plus one vessel.

38:8.note: "Mirrors of the serving women" rendered "sight of women who came to pray".

39:1.note: "From" repeated before each fabric; "plaited garments" rendered "garments of service".

39:18.note: "Two ends of the two cords" restructured.

39:26.note: "Bell and pomegranate" doubled rendered as plurals; plus "of gold".

39:30.note: "Holy crown" rendered "crown of naziriteship of holiness".

40:2.note: Date phrase compressed to 'on the first of the first month'.

40:8.note: Sabib rendered by circumstantial clause; plus 'upon'.

40:15.note: Syriac 'Aaron your brother' for 'their father'; lihyot not rendered.

40:17.note: Plus 'on the first (day) of the week'.

40:21.note: Free rendering 'the front of the door of the covering' for 'the curtain of the screen'.
